jcode hook system analysis (verified in /home/prem-modha/.jcode/source/jcode):

1. crates/jcode-base/src/hooks.rs — Two dispatch styles documented in module header:
   - Observers (turn_start, turn_end, session_start, session_end, post_tool): spawned detached, fire-and-forget. Failures logged, never affect the agent. HookEvent::new(event) at line ~44; hook_command(event) resolves config at ~86-91; dispatch_observer at ~200+ runs with Stdio::null().
   - Gate (pre_tool): run_pre_tool_gate at ~228. jcode waits (timeout pre_tool_timeout_ms), exit 0 allows, exit 2 blocks, stderr (capped BLOCK_REASON_LIMIT=2000) fed back to model. GateDecision enum {Allow, Block{reason}} at ~33. TOOL_INPUT_ENV_LIMIT=16KiB, PAYLOAD_ENV_LIMIT=16KiB.

2. crates/jcode-app-core/src/agent/turn_execution.rs — fire_turn_start_hook at ~99 (observer, before model), fire_turn_end_hook at ~115 (observer, after turn with result metadata). Both guarded by crate::hooks::hook_configured. fire_turn_end_hook builds HookEvent::new('turn_end') and calls crate::hooks::dispatch_observer(event) at ~143 — the natural insertion point for a gate variant that captures stdout and returns a followup.

3. crates/jcode-config-types/src/lib.rs — [hooks] config fields at ~757-793: turn_start, turn_end, session_start, session_end, pre_tool, post_tool (Option<String>), pre_tool_timeout_ms (u64, default). Doc comment: 'All hooks except pre_tool are observers... pre_tool is a gate: jcode waits for it and exit 2 blocks with stderr fed back.' Add turn_end_gate field (Option<String>) + turn_end_gate_timeout_ms mirroring pre_tool.

4. Followup injection point: after fire_turn_end_hook returns, the agent loop prepares the next turn. The injected followup_message must be appended as the next user/session instruction after the assistant turn. The natural place is in the same turn_execution path that sequences turns (turn execution loop in turn_execution.rs), gated on the new config field.

Contract for babysitter after-agent.sh compatibility:
- Hook emits JSON on stdout: {"decision":"block","followup_message":"<text>"}
- jcode waits for hook (timeout), parses stdout; valid block JSON => inject followup_message as next turn instruction
- exit 0 / no stdout / invalid JSON / exit 2 => no injection (observer behavior preserved)
- Existing herdr-agent-state.sh observer wiring must keep working unchanged
